articles.title: BBC to show England's World Cup semi-final

articles.title: Fifa official refuses to answer BBC's Balogun ban questions
articles.summary: The head of Fifa's disciplinary committee refuses to answer BBC questions about the decision-making process which led to United States striker Folarin Balogun avoiding a ban after being sent off.

articles.title: South Africa World Cup midfielder Adams dies aged 25
articles.summary: South Africa and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams dies at the age of 25, just weeks after featuring for his country at the World Cup.
